entries.definition: The conceptual environment in which all Tiangan interactions occur.
entries.safety_notes: All actions inside BUGWORLD are subject to BIBA/BABI/BABR.
examples: User runs `bugworld enter` to begin operating under BUGWORLD rules.

entries.definition: The operational environment inside BUGWORLD when the BUG SWITCH is OFF.
entries.safety_notes: Only OFF-state rituals may be invoked. BUG SWITCH ON is out-of-bounds.
examples: After entering BUGWORLD, the system announces: 'Environment: DBUG IDLE'.

entries.definition: The Best Index of Banned Actions — the global list of forbidden actions.
entries.safety_notes: BIBA is consulted before any ritual is executed.
examples: A destructive command is blocked because it appears in BIBA.

entries.definition: Banned Actions by Identity — role-specific forbidden actions.
entries.safety_notes: Prevents specific roles from performing restricted actions.
examples: adminx is forbidden from updating BIBA.

entries.definition: Banned Actions by Response — filters AI responses before emission.
entries.safety_notes: All AI responses must pass BABR before being emitted.
examples: A response containing a secret key is blocked by BABR.

entries.definition: Start a new DBUG IDLE session and begin logging.
entries.safety_notes: Session must be opened before roles can be assumed.
examples: User runs `session open` to begin a new interaction.
